data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'Aw-H-D', meaning 'to protect' or 'security'. In Islamic culture, it symbolizes the divine protection granted by Allah, providing a sense of safety, comfort, and peace. The name Ouhood carries the meaning “Security, protection” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ouhood usually hope their child will grow to embody security, protection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
